apps.name: Dispatcher
apps.description: Schedule outbound pickups and inbound arrivals, track load progress, and view daily timelines.
apps.releaseNotes:
Dispatcher 1.1.3

Swipe left or right on Inbounds and Outbounds to select the next or previous filter. A swipe must cover at least a quarter of the page width, with a 96 dp minimum, before switching on release. Short swipes, vertical scrolling, and search-field gestures do not switch filters. The Today page retains its existing timeline gestures.

Loading dots on Print and Start Loading buttons now draw as one compact indicator, preventing device fonts or display sizes from wrapping the dots onto another line.

Install over the existing app to retain saved settings and authorization. The package ID and signing certificate are unchanged.

apps.name: MES Radio
apps.description: Push-to-talk for your MES team. Talk on radio channels and replay received voice.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Radio 1.0.7

Live speech gets progressively quieter when the speaker is estimated to be within 5 meters. At 5 meters or beyond, it uses your saved Quiet, Medium or Loud level. Live speech is reduced, not fully muted.
Recordings keep their original audio, and Replay plays at your saved listening level regardless of how close the speaker was.
Works for regular channels and Broadcast. A nearby-speaker status explains when live volume is lowered.

Both phones must enable location sharing and have fresh positions reporting accuracy of 5 meters or better. Missing, old or imprecise positions leave live volume unchanged. Location remains an estimate, and sharing stops when the app leaves the foreground; this does not guarantee feedback prevention. Two-phone proximity and acoustic testing remain pending.

Keeps the Broadcast speaker toggle, speech-reactive glow, radar stabilization and connection recovery from previous releases.
Android 9 or newer. Updates MES Radio in place and preserves sign-in, settings and voice history. Do not uninstall before updating.

apps.name: MES Run Beta
apps.description: Run production, coordinate MES staff, and follow line progress in an isolated test environment.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Run Beta 13 - Daily-use UI Refinements

Smaller headings, tighter spacing and compact controls make line configuration, production setup and the floor easier to scan. Breadcrumbs stay aligned between pages. Machine profiles no longer display parameter counts.

Tap the info icon beside a machine parameter to read its configured description. Routine explanations now open on demand. The Review screen keeps before/after avatars, assignment changes and staffing shortages visible with less repeated text. Tap the reduced-production icon beside a step name to view that step's staffing details.

Update MES Run Beta in MES Store and use the existing test PIN. Try Swipe Line > Edit, Sort, Setup > Parameters, and the floor staffing indicators. The approved machine artwork and production workflow remain unchanged. Actual MES product identities, employees, attendance and machine profiles remain linked; production commands, quantities, raw materials and product fill weights remain isolated sample data.

Normal and enlarged-text native checks use emulator debug builds. Signed-release installation and the MES Store installation flow remain unverified because automatic approval review previously blocked those checks. Pallet label printing is a separate app; physical printing, inspector submissions and live Andon input are outside this release.

apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Your workplace apps, without the hunt for download links.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.2.20

Adds independent release approval for every APK, including updates to MES Store itself. The store blocks missing or invalid approvals before downloading or opening an installation session, and rechecks the APK before installation.

Approval is tied to the exact APK bytes, package, version, Android requirement, signing certificate, size, and download URL. Replacing an APK and its catalog checksum does not make it approved. The verification key is built into MES Store; its separate private approval key is kept outside GitHub.

All six current apps have been verified and approved. App introductions, Featured text, and help links remain independently editable. Valid cached app information remains available offline.

Install the genuine 1.2.20 update to enable this protection. It covers installations through MES Store and assumes the separate approval key, signing computer, and device remain trusted. It cannot control manual installation outside the store. Existing installations retain their settings and data; Android 9 or newer, with the same package ID and APK signing key.
